records.fit_tier_meaning: The pair will understand one another quickly, but the same strengths and traps can multiply.
records.dynamic: The Innovator leading another The Innovator creates fast rapport because both naturally focus on creating possibility, new ideas and future direction. The opportunity is fluency; the danger is that the same strengths and the same shadow are amplified at the TEAM level.
records.lead_them_by: Finish before adding. Translate vision into a clear outcome, listen to feedback and let operators own execution. Translate the outcome into a clear role, daily standard and practical next action. Give the destination, the problem worth solving and the few non-negotiables. Protect room for ideas, but convert them into one selected priority and a finish line.
records.communicate: Lead with the future, the problem worth solving and the few non-negotiables. Keep detail available, not dominant. As The Innovator, translate your natural style so the message lands: keep the outcome clear, separate facts from enthusiasm and confirm what the other person heard.
records.motivate: Connect their natural driver to the work and recognise evidence, not personality. For The Innovator, emphasise ownership of a new challenge, visible impact, creative freedom and the chance to build something that did not exist.
records.watch_out: You will create energy quickly, but both may keep adding ideas, change direction and leave execution behind.
records.trait_to_borrow: Borrow from The Innovator: A visionary who chooses the right ideas, creates clear goals and empowers operators to execute. Use that trait to counter the risk that, under pressure, chases new ideas, changes direction, over-involves themselves and loses operational focus.
